definitions.explanation: Being the same in quantity, value, or status.

examples.japanese: この{二|ふた}つの{三角形|さんかっけい}は{面積|めんせき}が{等|ひと}しい。
examples.english: These two triangles have equal areas.

examples.japanese: {全員|ぜんいん}に{等|ひと}しく{機会|きかい}を{与|あた}えるべきだ。
examples.english: Opportunities should be given equally to everyone.

examples.japanese: {何|なに}もしないのは{失敗|しっぱい}に{等|ひと}しい。
examples.english: Doing nothing is equivalent to failure.

examples.japanese: あの{二人|ふたり}の{実力|じつりょく}は{等|ひと}しい。
{彼|かれ}の{態度|たいど}は{無礼|ぶれい}に{等|ひと}しいものだった。
examples.english: His attitude was tantamount to rudeness.

notes:
Often used in mathematical, logical, or comparative contexts.

FORMS:
・{等|ひと}しい (plain form)
・{等|ひと}しく (adverb form: equally)
・〜に{等|ひと}しい (to be equal to ~)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・AはBに{等|ひと}しい (A equals B)
・〜に{等|ひと}しい (equivalent to ~)
・{等|ひと}しく{分|わ}ける (to divide equally)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{同|おな}じ - same, identical
・{等|ひと}しい - equal (more formal, often mathematical)
・{平等|びょうどう} - equality (noun/na-adj)
